_comment: A single simultaneous snapshot of the reference implementation running in
production: every input it read, and every answer it produced from them.
This is what makes 'faithful port' a claim pytest can check. If the ported
model ever stops reproducing these outputs from these inputs, something
changed that nobody meant to change.
Timings and the best window are not replayed here: they are derived from a
48-hour forecast that was not captured alongside the readings, and a
reconstructed forecast would only be testing itself.
The reference implementation scored only the sunroom. The laundry room
is included in inputs because it is viable at the same time (it scores
8.55 here, above the sunroom's 8.24) — which is precisely the gap this
integration exists to close, so its expected score is asserted
separately rather than being claimed as reference parity.
reference_outputs.drying_advice: Sunroom now (8.2, moderate). Sun 4.2 vs cover 2.9. Outside will not beat inside today; if it is out, in by 17:51. Best Sun 11:00-16:00 (peak 16.2). Dew overnight.

expected_new_outputs._comment: What this integration should produce that the reference could not.
